Priya (Head of Eng): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Thread for clarifications on release cadence, oncall, quality gates, SLAs. Drop short notes or edge cases.

Sam (Head of Product): Product asks: when is a change "major" vs "minor"? Need a single-sentence rule we can ship with PRs.

Nora (Eng Manager): Suggestion: Major = affects API contract, model weights, or requires a DB migration. Minor = perf tweaks, config, infra that doesn't change contracts.

Diego (SRE): On oncall cadence: team asked to try 2w primary instead of 3w. Ops recommends 2w primary + 1w overlap (shadow) to reduce handoff noise. We'll measure pages during overlap.

Priya (Head of Eng): Good. Pilot runtime + api-platform teams for one quarter, collect metrics (pages, ack times, handover issues).

Sam (Head of Product): About quality bars: product concerned about noisy eval alerts. What are blocking thresholds?

Diego (SRE): Initial thresholds: golden-set relevance drop >4% relative OR hallucination increase >5% absolute OR 95p latency >10% reg. Tune per model family. Alerts go to model owners + release lead.

Nora (Eng Manager): If a release is blocked by evals, what's the SLA to respond? Teams need clear timings.

Diego (SRE): Protocol: ack within 4 business hours for P1 block, mitigation plan within 24 hours. If unresolved after 48 hours, release lead + product + reliability escalate.

ci-bot: Reminder: add "release-ready checklist" template to PRs: CI green, perf sanity, rollback tested, docs updated. https://redwood.internal/releases/templates

Priya (Head of Eng): Action items: @Diego PR with oncall pilot schedule + metrics by EOW; @Nora add release-ready PR template; @Sam classify next release changes as major/minor. I'll synthesize a one-pager after PRs land.

Sam (Head of Product): I'll coordinate PMs to label upcoming changes. Drop any cross-service migration cases here. :thumbsup:
